description:
## Why

Final leg of PKIX-g9vc. Produces the committed baseline data and the hand-classification artefact that the project expects (matching the PKITS pattern: `baseline-pkits.json` machine + `baseline-pkits-analysis.md` curated).

## What

1. Run the full corpus end-to-end:
   ```
   cargo run --release -p pkix-difftest -- run limbo \
     ~/GIT/x509-limbo/limbo.json \
     --oracles pkix-path,openssl,pyca \
     --output-md pkix-difftest/baseline-limbo.md \
     --output-json pkix-difftest/baseline-limbo.json \
     --title "pkix-difftest baseline (x509-limbo Tier-2)"
   ```
   Expected wall time: ~15 min × 3 oracles ≈ 45 min (pyca subprocess startup dominates).
2. Commit `baseline-limbo.json` and `baseline-limbo.md`.
3. Write `pkix-difftest/baseline-limbo-analysis.md` (curated, mirrors `baseline-pkits-analysis.md` structure):
   - Summary table: Agreement / LooserThanWild / StricterThanWild / OracleDivergence / DiagnosticDivergence counts.
   - Bucket every `LooserThanWild` and `StricterThanWild` divergence by failure category (policy, name constraints, EKU, signature alg, time, etc.).
   - For each bucket: brief rationale + decide whether it's a real divergence (file follow-up bead) or expected (project policy comment, like `pkix-path-rfc-strict-vs-openssl-lenient` memory).
4. File follow-up beads for any real divergences uncovered.
5. Update workspace AGENTS.md or pkix-difftest/README.md to mention x509-limbo as a supported corpus.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `baseline-limbo.json` + `baseline-limbo.md` committed.
- [ ] `baseline-limbo-analysis.md` committed, matches PKITS-analysis structure.
- [ ] Every `LooserThanWild`/`StricterThanWild` entry has either a follow-up bead or an inline justification.
- [ ] README references the limbo corpus path.

## Depends on

- PKIX-g9vc.1, PKIX-g9vc.2, PKIX-g9vc.3 (all of the above plumbing).

## Out of scope

- CI integration of limbo runs (covered by PKIX-klku).
- Per-testcase divergence drill-down beyond bucket classification (those become individual follow-up beads).
- Refreshing pyca `.venv` if it goes stale (operational, not in this bead).

## Filed as

Final decomposition of PKIX-g9vc. Closes the umbrella when done.
title: pkix-difftest: run x509-limbo baseline + curated analysis
